title: Metering guard: a zero catalog or overlay price on a hosted entry not marked open_weight is counted as unpriced (so the 5 % unpriced share trips) instead of a free config price
description: From sprint-257 audit a257-1 LOW-A3 (dissent DISS-C-003): a project overlay pricing {0,0} on a hosted non-open_weight model zeroes both the pre-call estimate and the ledger cost, so neither budget_cents nor metering.budget.daily_micro_usd trips. The fix round adds a WARN in the dissent budget gate; this bead is the metering-side guard: pricing_source_for / the ledger treat a zero price on a non-open_weight hosted entry as unknown (unpriced), with the catalog provenance test extended. Decide the free-tier exception shape (an explicit pricing.free: true marker) before implementing.

verdict-derive: integer-only trailer fields, case-insensitive marker strip and Observations scan, diagnostics for trailer-less review files
description: Sprint-237 audit M5-M7/L5, all reproduced on scratchpad copies. (1) .claude/scripts/verdict-derive.sh:154 trailer_int returns integral floats (2.0, 1E+5) verbatim and the (( )) comparisons at :287/:290/:303 turn the arithmetic syntax error into false, so an audit with excluded_confirmed:2.0 against a review excluded:3 prints CONSISTENT rc=0 (golden-path.sh:139 still denies via ^[0-9]{1,6}$). (2) :296-300 the --review-file cross-check strips the marker case-sensitively while detecting it case-insensitively, so a lowercase <!-- loa-verdict ... excluded:3 --> review reads as excluded=0 and an audit excluded_confirmed:0 passes standalone (golden path denies because the review file fails its own gate first). (3) :138-139 observations_scan matches only uppercase CRITICAL/HIGH; '- **Critical**: ...' under ## Observations with a zeroed APPROVED trailer passes verdict-derive and _gp_sprint_is_audited. (4) :294 a trailer-less legacy review file makes grep|tail exit 1 under pipefail with no violation text and no JSON. Fix: trailer_int requires (type==number and .==floor and tostring matches ^[0-9]{1,6}$); strip with the same -i as detect; scan the lowercased line; || true at :294 with a named violation. VO-12..VO-15 failing first.
